g4-implement.title: G4 held-out-weekend diagnostic (strictly-pre): implement
g4-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G4. Task: build scripts/run_heldout_diagnostic_670.py that, over the consolidated season slice, for each held-out weekend W (round R with sufficient strictly-prior data) predicts each driver's per-class utilization observable using THREE priors, then scores them against W's ACTUAL observed observable. ALL THREE arms are STRICTLY-PRE -- every DRIVER-PERFORMANCE input must be drawn only from rounds < R: (1) fingerprint x composition = join_weekend_prior(W composition, driver cells fit as_of_round=R-1); (2) driver-overall-only baseline = join_weekend_prior(UNIFORM composition, the SAME cells) [the join's T7-1 unweighted-cell-mean form - the ONE documented baseline; state+justify per #667 TC-1]; (3) golf null = the field/no-driver-term prediction: predict every driver's per-class observable by the STRICTLY-PRIOR field mean per class (pooled over rounds<R, NO driver term) weighted by W's composition -- pin this definition explicitly in code + report; its field pool MUST exclude round R. LEAKAGE-CRITICAL, covering EVERY arm's inputs: the fingerprint fit AND the golf-null field pool MUST see ZERO round-R (or later) rows -- use as_of_round=R-1 / round_idx<R (fit uses round_idx<=as_of_round INCLUSIVE); assert in code AND test each arm. COMPOSITION HANDLING (leakage-flagged by cold critic): W's composition is the circuit corner-severity time-share = a TRACK-GEOMETRY property (corner mix), used identically as track structure by all three arms; document explicitly that it is track layout (not the predicted driver's performance), note it is derived from W's reference lap, and -- where a strictly-prior same-circuit composition exists in the slice (prior year is NOT in a 2023-only slice, so this may be absent) -- add a sensitivity readout; surface the composition-source caveat prominently in the report. Score via a predictive metric honoring Student-t sigma (mean predictive log-score + interval coverage + mean |resid|); report per-prior aggregate + per-class/per-channel breakdown. Emit the diagnostic report (md+json) to an isolated out-dir. STATE in the report that this sizes COMPOSITION-WEIGHTING value (arm1 vs arm2) and WHOLE-DRIVER-TERM value (arms 1/2 vs golf null) -- not the full hierarchical pool vs an independent aggregate. Add tests/unit/physics/fingerprint/test_heldout_diagnostic.py incl.: LEAKAGE-GUARD tests for BOTH the fingerprint fit AND the golf-null field pool (no round>=R rows enter either); golf-null-is-the-floor sanity; T7-1-baseline-equals-uniform-composition. Dispatch constellation-implementer; integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
